# SuperFocus

> A free Pomodoro timer with to-do lists, sprint planning, goals and 10 focus music tracks. Install the offline PWA; your tasks stay on your device.

SuperFocus is part of lowkey.tools, built by Shrinath Prabhu, from the makers of OwlEye Analytics.
Canonical app URL: https://lowkey.tools/superfocus. The subdomain superfocus.lowkey.tools is an alternate entry point.
Workspace data is device-local, with no account or cloud sync. Background alarms are best effort and cannot run reliably when the app is closed or suspended.

## App guide
- [SuperFocus facts and frequently asked questions](https://lowkey.tools/superfocus/index.md): Plain-text features, setup, privacy, music and alarm limitations.
- [SuperFocus workspace](https://lowkey.tools/superfocus): The interactive Pomodoro timer and sprint planner.

## Makers
- [OwlEye Analytics](https://owleye.dev): From the makers of OwlEye Analytics.
- [Shrinath Prabhu](https://shrinath.me): SuperFocus creator and frontend engineer.
- [lowkey.tools](https://lowkey.tools): The tools collection that includes SuperFocus.
